parts.hook: Master Urokodaki handed him a pitch-black sword and a sealed wooden box—unaware this blade was an omen of death!
parts.narration: Tanjiro Kamado's journey from a grieving charcoal seller into an elite demon hunter begins the moment he dons the official uniform of the Demon Slayer Corps. Woven from specialized, indestructible fibers laced with wisteria minerals, this garment provides impenetrable defense against minor demon claws and fire while retaining maximum flexibility for high-speed swordplay. But as Tanjiro fastens his iconic checkered haori, Master Urokodaki reveals a chilling truth regarding the pitch-black Nichirin blade resting at his hip. Throughout the centuries-long records of the Corps, black-blade wielders have remained an ominous mystery; virtually none of them lived long enough to uncover their true breathing affinity or leave behind combat manuscripts. Unbeknownst to Tanjiro, black steel signifies an affinity for the primordial Sun itself. To ensure Nezuko's survival in the daytime world, the former Water Hashira gifts Tanjiro a custom-crafted box forged from sacred Kirin cedar. Coated in heavy natural lacquer, its light-resistant walls prevent fatal UV exposure while Nezuko recovers through mystical slumber. Hoisting his sister onto his shoulders with unwavering resolve, Tanjiro takes his fateful first strides down Mount Sagiri, stepping directly onto the brutal frontline where humans and demons clash.
parts.cliffhanger: Will Tanjiro find the missing girls in the northwestern town? Watch Part 2!

parts.hook: Young girls were vanishing into thin air every night, and the town accused a grieving fiancé of murder!
parts.narration: Dispatched on his very first official assignment by his talking Kasugai crow, Tanjiro arrives in a bustling northwestern town. Yet beneath the vibrant daytime facade of vendor stalls and busy cobblestones lies an atmosphere of suffocating paranoia. Every single night, young maidens have been vanishing without leaving a single drop of blood or sign of forced entry. Tanjiro encounters Kazumi, a devastated young man hollowed out by grief and ostracized by the village. Just the previous evening, Kazumi was walking side-by-side with his bride Satoko when she literally dematerialized into the ground beneath their feet, leading the ignorant townsfolk to brand him a murderer. Tanjiro immediately recognizes the telltale agony in Kazumi's eyes and believes his story without hesitation. Dropping to his knees directly onto the dirt road, Tanjiro deploys his superhuman sense of smell. By filtering out the background scents of food and street dust, he pinpoints a faint, repulsive odor of rotting sulfur—confirming that a demon possesses the supernatural ability to traverse beneath the solid earth.
parts.cliffhanger: The demon strikes again from the shadows—watch Part 3 for the explosive clash!

parts.hook: The cobblestones dissolved into liquid swamp, dragging an innocent girl straight toward a demonic maw!
parts.narration: As midnight plunges the northwestern alleys into darkness, the sulfuric scent spikes with terrifying intensity. Ahead in the shadows, another young maiden screams as the solid ground liquefies into a viscous, pitch-black swamp puddle that drags her downward. Tanjiro reacts with instantaneous combat reflexes, sprinting across the alley, plunging his Nichirin sword deep into the mud, and yanking the unconscious girl free just milliseconds before she is consumed whole. Rising from the dark surface is the Swamp Demon, gnashing his teeth with an irritating, rhythmic clatter that signals his predatory agitation. This repulsive creature has terrorized the region for months, preying exclusively on young girls whose flesh he believes is most tender, including Kazumi's beloved Satoko. Watching Kazumi weep beside the demon's sinister sneer ignites pure, unbridled fury within Tanjiro. Leaping high into the night sky to harness maximum gravitational acceleration, Tanjiro executes Water Breathing Eighth Form: Waterfall Basin! Crashing straight downward with a concentrated vertical kinetic shockwave, his blade cleaves through the demon's defenses and shatters the cobblestones beneath!
parts.cliffhanger: The demon isn't alone—watch Part 4 to see Nezuko kick into action!

parts.hook: The Swamp Demon cloned into three killers, but Nezuko's explosive kick smashed through everything!
parts.narration: The crushing impact demolishes the street, yet the Swamp Demon survives through an unexpected Blood Demon Art: his body splits into three separate clones, each slipping into the subterranean marsh to encircle Tanjiro from every angle. Tanjiro is forced into a tactical dilemma—staying on the surface to shield Kazumi and the unconscious victim leaves him wide open to underground ambushes. Just as the third clone claws out of the wall to rip Kazumi apart, the wooden box on Tanjiro's back violently trembles—and Nezuko kicks the door clean off its hinges! Her demonic pink eyes blazing with protective fury, Nezuko unleashes a devastating axe kick that sends the demon violently ricocheting into a stone barrier. Under Master Urokodaki's hypnotic conditioning, Nezuko sees all humans as her fallen siblings and demons as merciless monsters to destroy. Realizing his sister can dominate the surface threat, Tanjiro takes a full breath of Total Concentration and dives headfirst into the swamp portal, bringing the fight directly into the demon's submerged territory!
